description: THE VARIATION REPERTOIRE AS GRAPH DATA (Wave 5). `_compose_experiment_rule`'s variant chain (`if conversation: reply_ablation elif judge+structure: structural elif judge+gradient: threshold_shift`) reified as VariationOp nodes + a held `variation_pick` Program, following the composer_dispatch precedent exactly: the Program returns the op NAME, Python does a name-keyed registry lookup on the verdict (`_VARIATION_REGISTRY`), never an if/elif over graph state. Each VariationOp carries: `cue_head` (the grounded relation head that makes the family applicable -- replay for the conversation families, structure/gradient for the ARC families), `also_head` (a second head that must ALSO have grounded, '' if none -- encodes the old chain's `judge and structure` / `judge and gradient` conjunctions), `requires_kind` (the promoted concern's SelfConcern kind this family is scoped to, '' for any -- cue_set_edit only makes sense for an `instruction` gap, whose content names an unrouted verb), and `priority` (Argmin, lower wins -- preserves the old chain's ordering: conversation families outrank structure outranks gradient; within conversation, an instruction-kind concern picks cue_set_edit over the generic reply_ablation). THE AGENT EDITING A VariationOp NODE (priority, cue, requires_kind, route_pool) CHANGES WHICH VARIATION AN EXPERIMENT TRIES -- that is the point: the choice is self-repairable graph data (gated in tests/test_agent_authors_new_rule_migrated.py). `cue_set_edit` is the genuinely-new-behaviour constructor (Wave 1b/2 made instruction verbs Concept{name, instruction_route} data, so a cue-set edit is a complete variation: variant = add a route Concept, applied by the child runners' add_concepts delta). Its `route_pool` attr declares WHICH routes the family may construct with (the routes whose seed rules claim any verb+content generically -- world_action / comprehend_text; the reflexive/steering routes need shapes a bare verb+object turn doesn't have), agent-editable data, read by the held `cue_route_pick` Program: candidates are the route-carrying Concepts whose route is in the pool, scored by character-BIGRAM overlap with the gap verb (RULE_SIGNATURE_PRODUCTION_WIRING_RESULTS.md v1.4.0: replaces the old per-character overlap, which scored anagram-shaped verbs like 'drop'/'prod' byte-identically against every candidate -- SHAPE_AUDIT.md's own worst-instance finding; a v1 held similarity, still only ordering proposals -- honest abstain at zero overlap; the EXPERIMENT is the real validator of the pick, the score only orders proposals), already-routed verbs abstain (nothing to construct). Both Programs are Term-trees the Rust evaluator runs; Python passes env only. || RESIDUAL-CLOSURE (v1.1.0): `knob_edit` is the held-NODE-ATTR twin of `threshold_shift` -- where `threshold_shift` only reaches a threshold LITERAL embedded in a chosen_action-writing rule's own effects (via RuleSummary provenance), a great many held beliefs (e.g. ApertureBudget's per-register reading thresholds, seeds/reading_aperture.json) are plain NODE ATTRS with no owning acting rule at all. `knob_edit` cues on `bound` (the RelationCue a concern's own content words ground when they name 'threshold'/'bound'/'scale'/'limit'/'constraint' -- see seeds/relation_vocabulary.json's `bounded` cue), `also_head` '' -- 'bound' ONLY grounds when the concern's own content names threshold vocabulary, which is exactly the family's applicability condition, so no conjunction is needed. Priority 15: below cue_set_edit (10 -- an instruction-kind gap's unrouted verb stays a routing problem even when its object phrase mentions a threshold) but above reply_ablation (20) and both ARC families, so a threshold-naming concern in EITHER bundle prefers the knob family; a concern that never grounds 'bound' leaves every other family's ordering byte-identical. The variant rides the SeedDelta as `set_node_attrs` ({type, key_attr, key_value, attrs} -- applied by both child runners' apply_node_attr_delta); adoption applies the SAME attr change to the parent's own node with the old value captured on the Adoption record (revert = restore it); the verdict is seeds/self_optimisation.json's judge_knob_experiment_outcome over the child's CONTROLLED double-pass replay (control pass at the parent's held value, then the knob, then the variant pass -- fewer reform marks supports, tied is inconclusive, more or any regression refutes). `knob_step` is the fixed v1 magnitude added to the picked knob's current value (direction is currently ALWAYS +, matching the motivating case: 'fires too eagerly' -> raise the bar; reading the opposite polarity out of the content to flip direction is a named residual, not built here) and `default_key_value` is the held default row-selector (the register a knob_edit experiment targets when the candidate node type keys rows by a `register` attr, e.g. ApertureBudget -- 'conversational', the register every conversation-replay experiment runs under). || WHERE-CLAUSE-VARIATION (v1.2.0): `rule_literal_edit` reaches the residual `knob_edit` names but does not close: a WHERE-CLAUSE numeric literal (a Gte/Gt/Lte/Lt comparison's own Lit operand, e.g. reading_aperture's `sentences_read >= 3.0` or salient_cache's `sc_mentions >= 3.0`) embedded in a rule that is NEITHER a chosen_action writer (threshold_shift's scope) NOR owns a held node-attr belief (knob_edit's scope) -- a plain WHERE-GUARD literal on an otherwise-ordinary comprehension/salience rule. `rule_literal_edit` cues on `ruleliteral` (a NEW, DISJOINT RelationCue -- 'floor'/'literal'/'hardcoded', deliberately NOT reusing `bounded`'s 'threshold'/'bound'/'limit'/'scale'/'constraint' vocabulary, so a concern naming a HELD KNOB still grounds ONLY `bound` and a concern naming a bare RULE LITERAL grounds ONLY `ruleliteral` -- no cue-word collision, so the two families never compete on the SAME concern's pick; see seeds/relation_vocabulary.json's `bounded` cue for the words this family must never claim). PRIORITY 18: below cue_set_edit (10) and knob_edit (15, so a concern that genuinely names a held knob is untouched) but above reply_ablation (20) and both ARC families (30/40), so a rule-literal-naming concern that grounds ONLY 'replay'+'ruleliteral' (never 'bound') prefers this family over the conversation fallback (reply_ablation), which cannot reach a where-clause guard at all (it only ablates reply-minting rules) and would otherwise abstain uselessly on these residuals. WHICH rule + WHICH literal: `_ensure_where_literal_rule_provenance` (domains/reflective_faculty.py) mirrors EVERY active rule carrying >=1 numeric where-clause comparison (found by `_find_where_lits`, `where`-only -- a shift here can only change WHETHER the rule fires as a THRESHOLD, never its effects) as `RuleSummary.writes_where_literal` (the where-clause twin of `_ensure_acting_rule_provenance`/`_ensure_reply_rule_provenance` -- same from_seed/skippable provenance, same upgrade-in-place idempotence); `_compose_rule_literal_variant` Argmaxes over (rule, literal) pairs by token overlap between the promoted concern's own content words and each literal's own comparison-subtree vocabulary (every Attr key, NodesOfType type name, and short string Lit value reachable from that ONE comparison node, `_'-split, lowercased) -- the SAME >=2-word minimum-signal discipline `_compose_knob_variant` uses, honest abstain below it (a rule-literal residual whose content only says 'threshold' and nothing else lands here as an abstain, not a random pick). WHICH DIRECTION: `direction_lexicon_more`/`direction_lexicon_fewer` (agent-editable word lists below) score the SAME content against 'fires too rarely/never' (increase_fires: lower a >=/> floor, raise a <=/< ceiling) vs 'fires too eagerly/often' (decrease_fires: the opposite) -- a tied or zero-zero score abstains (no random polarity), never Python if/elif on the words themselves (a dict/set membership read against held lexicon data, the same class of operation `_compose_knob_variant`'s own token-overlap Argmax already performs in Python). `literal_step` (1.0, not knob_edit's 0.1) is the fixed v1 magnitude: these literals are integer-domain counts (sentence/entity/event/message/turn/mention counts), so a fractional shift would be inert against an integer gate -- the SAME 'unscaled, integer-domain' reasoning `_compose_acting_variant`'s own docstring gives for threshold_shift's ARC-side literals. The variant rides the SeedDelta exactly like threshold_shift/structural_edit (`remove_rules`=[original], `add_rules`=[a `_shift_one_where_literal`-built copy named `<original>_variant_<tag>`], `act_rule_varied`=original -- so BOTH the existing generic `mark_adopt_ready_*` rule's genuine-variant check AND `perform_adoptions`'s generic remove_rule/add_rule fold-back apply UNCHANGED, zero new adoption code needed) plus `rule_literal_edit`=1.0/`rule_literal_old_value`/`rule_literal_new_value`/`rule_literal_direction`/`rule_literal_witness` (a JSON-encoded `{type:'typed', node_type, attrs}` or `{type:'attr_any', attr, value}` structural witness `_rule_effect_witness` reads off the ORIGINAL rule's own effects -- prefers a typed add_node mint's own literal attrs, else the first literal set_attr -- so the dispatched child can COUNT this rule's own fires mechanically, never by name). The verdict is seeds/self_optimisation.json's judge_rule_literal_outcome over the child's CONTROLLED double-pass (control pass at the ORIGINAL rule, then the rule swap, then the variant pass -- the SAME run-15 protected-control shape knob_edit's judge uses, but swapping a RULE rather than a NODE ATTR): any regression refutes; else the witness-fire delta compared against `rule_literal_direction` (increase_fires supports iff variant_witness > control_witness; decrease_fires supports iff variant_witness < control_witness; equal is inconclusive; the wrong-way delta refutes) -- the verdict is checked against what the CONCERN ASKED FOR, not a fixed sign. || COMPOSER-CAPABILITY (v1.3.0): two more variation families close the composer's own self-diagnosed shortfall ("you cannot author a rule that feeds a recorded datum back into a held belief", filed 2026-07-11). `datum_feedback_rule` cues on `datumfeedback` (a NEW, DISJOINT RelationCue -- 'reliability'/'trust'/'trustworthiness'/'recalibrate'/'recalibration'/'miscalibrated', never overlapping `bounded`'s or `rule_literal_floor`'s own vocabulary) and AUTHORS a genuinely NEW, ADD-ONLY rule (no rule removed -- reflective_faculty._compose_datum_feedback_rule Argmaxes over the held _DATUM_FEEDBACK_CANDIDATES table, same >=2-word minimum-signal discipline, to pick WHICH (datum attr, belief attr) pair on WHICH node type the concern names) that matches every party the agent models (`agent -has_interlocutor-> party`, the boundary edge interlocutor_model._ensure_party_anchor mechanically maintains -- deliberately its own edge type, not a reuse of senses/models/acts_on, whose counts are load-bearing theorem invariants elsewhere), guarded by an EPOCH marker (the datum's own value != a stamped 'last applied' value -- fires again exactly when the datum genuinely changes, never a boolean flag) and moves the belief by this VariationOp's own held `datum_step`, clamped to [`belief_floor`, `belief_ceil`] (the reading_norms/ApertureBudget clamp idiom, agent-editable data) -- v1 direction is FIXED (the belief moves down as the datum accrues, matching the motivating case), the SAME documented v1 scope limit `knob_edit`'s own fixed '+' direction carries. Priority 16 (below cue_set_edit/knob_edit, above rule_literal_edit/reply_ablation/the ARC families) so a reliability-naming concern in the standard conversation bundle prefers this family. `shape_mint` cues on `shapemint` (keywords: 'persona'/'profile'/'personas'/'profiles'/'unclassified'/'noshape') and CONSTRUCTS a brand-new InterlocutorShape node (the sd-loop mint applied to person-shapes) from the party carrying the LARGEST poor-fit streak (interlocutor_model._record_shape_fit's own mechanical datum -- a party whose accumulated features currently fit no held shape, decode_shape's own `_SHAPE_FIT_MIN` floor), signature = that party's own dominant register/cadence/style/affect (interlocutor_model._dominant_features -- the SAME plurality read decode_shape's fit scoring already uses), priors copied WIDE from the codebook's own `default_uncalibrated` entry. Rides the EXISTING `add_concepts` channel (already generalized to typed nodes, commit 03630c0e27) -- no new SeedDelta channel. Priority 17. Both families are ADD-ONLY: adoption installs (native.add_rule / teach()-persisted InterlocutorShape) rather than remove-then-replace, mirroring `cue_set_edit`'s own no-denylist adoption precedent (nothing removed, so `_rule_denylisted` never applies) -- reflective_faculty.perform_adoptions/revert_adoption gained matching branches, gated in tests/test_composer_capability_migrated.py.
